plain_text:
Jackson Beck appears in 174 recordings across 21 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive in 1979. The credits here include performer, announcer, commercial spokesman, and doubles.

In this archive, you will hear Jackson Beck most often in Philo Vance, CBS Radio Mystery Theater, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Theater Five, Inner Sanctum Mysteries, Words at War, CBS Radio Workshop, and Boston Blackie.

Characters credited here include Philo Vance and The Cisco Kid.
